name: Cydney Campbell Webster
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Cydney has been successfully representing injured individuals across Washington State since 1993. A Shareholder at GLP Attorneys and a key leader on the firm’s Seattle team, she is widely recognized for her skill in handling complex construction injury, automobile accident, and defective product cases. Cydney’s leadership in the firm’s construction injury practice has helped secure significant recoveries for workers and their families.

Over her three decades of practice, Cydney has built a reputation for combining tenacious advocacy with deep compassion for her clients. Her proven track record of achieving high-value settlements and favorable outcomes reflects her meticulous case preparation and commitment to justice for those harmed by negligence.

Beyond her legal practice, Cydney plays an active leadership role within GLP Attorneys, serving on several internal committees focused on leadership and professional development, technology enhancements, and improving the overall client experience. Her forward-thinking approach helps ensure the firm continues to deliver exceptional service while fostering innovation and growth among its teams.

Cydney is an Eagle member of the Washington State Association for Justice, a longtime Super Lawyer honoree (2007–2025), and a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum. She maintains a 10.0 Avvo rating and is also an active member of the American Association for Justice.
Cydney earned her undergraduate degree from Seattle University and her Juris Doctorate from the University of Puget Sound.
